moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: I resigned from Anthropic today… Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self‑improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives.
moments.why: An AI insider’s resignation post warning of existential risk has gone massively viral—striking a nerve with men 25–45 talking about tech and the future.

moments.author: Evan Hubinger
moments.quote: I personally think it is >10% within the next decade that AI could kill all humans.
moments.why: A senior Anthropic staffer amplified the viral resignation by confirming the severity—adding fuel to the conversation about AI risk.

moments.author: Illinois Gov. J.B. Pritzker
moments.quote: It's becoming more clear the threat AI poses to humanity, so I'm calling for immediate action from the industry and Washington.
moments.why: A politician jumping into the viral AI debate—showing it’s not just tech bros but also public figures are now deeply engaged.
